notes: v7.6.2: Repair-McpPaths corrupted JSON configs. It matched the path literal as written, and a JSON config stores every separator doubled, so the replacement mixed escaping levels (one attempt produced a lone backslash mid-path, the next four) - which would have made ~/.kimi-code/mcp.json unparseable. Caught only because the tool defaults to report-only. Now normalises the doubled form before touching the filesystem and re-applies the config's own escaping with String.Replace (not -replace, which is regex on both sides). Gate section 8 gained three assertions incl. an end-to-end round trip that the repointed JSON still parses. First CI for this repo: .github/workflows/ci.yml runs the pack gate on windows-latest under Windows PowerShell 5.1 (Desktop edition asserted, since the pack targets 5.1's encoding and BOM behaviour), plus MANIFEST hash verification and a version-consistency check across README, START-HERE, the installer banner and state, CATALOG.json, VALIDATION.json and the changelogs. PACK GATE: PASS (9 sections).
